{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=22|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Vatican City]]
**[[Pope Francis]], in a call for a worldwide prayer, announces he will hold a special service to pray for the end of the [[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-pope/pope-calls-for-world-prayer-to-stop-coronavirus-will-deliver-special-blessing-idUSKBN2190JH (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
***[[Dubai]]-based airline [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates]] announces that it will be suspending all passenger flights effective March 25 in response to the [[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]], but will continue to operate cargo flights for essential goods. [https://apnews.com/10aa229f979a05241ede3c349f5e4d2d (Associated Press)]
**[[Economy of the United States]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Senate|Senate]] votes down a [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]] relief stimulus bill. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/22/coronavirus-stimulus-congress-struggles-to-reach-a-deal.html (CNBC)]
***[[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Senate|Senate]] [[Party leaders of the United States Senate|Majority Leader]] [[Mitch McConnell]] is expected to set up a second vote on a [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]] relief stimulus bill for Monday.  [https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/488953-mcconnell-sets-second-coronavirus-vote-for-shortly-after-markets-open-monday (''The Hill'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Zagreb earthquake]]
**A 5.3-magnitude earthquake hits [[Zagreb]], [[Croatia]]. Seventeen people are injured; one is in critical condition. The earthquake is Zagreb's largest since [[1880 Zagreb earthquake|1880]]. [https://www.rt.com/news/483748-magnitude-60-earthquake-hits-croatia/ (RT)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51995861 (BBC News)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-03-22/strong-earthquake-shakes-croatia-damage-reported (Bloomberg News)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] observes a 14-hour nationwide self-imposed [[Janata Curfew]] amid the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/politics-and-nation/india-observes-janata-curfew-millions-stay-indoors/articleshow/74756225.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
****[[India]] suspends the entry of international flights due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/coronavirus-no-international-flights-will-be-allowed-to-land-in-india-from-march-22-for-a-week-2197474 (NDTV)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Palestinian territories]]
****The [[Palestinian National Authority]] confirms the first cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. Both patients are Palestinian men in their 30s who recently returned from [[Egypt]]. They are being held in [[quarantine]] in the border town of [[Rafah]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/first-coronavirus-cases-confirmed-in-gaza-1.8697755 (''Haaretz'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Afghanistan]]
****[[Afghanistan]]'s [[Ministry of Public Health (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Public Health]] reports its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a 40-year-old man in [[Balkh Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-afghanistan/afghanistan-reports-first-confirmed-death-from-coronavirus-health-ministry-idUSL4N2BF0DO (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] orders companies in [[Tashkent]] to do remote working and makes protective masks as an effort to contain the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-uzbekistan-idUSL8N2BF0JZ (Reuters)]
***[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in mainland China]], [[2020 Hubei lockdowns]]
****[[China]] reports only one domestic case of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] but reports 45 imported cases. [https://www.news18.com/news/world/china-reports-first-local-coronavirus-case-after-3-day-gap-sees-surge-in-imported-infections-2546103.html (CNN-News 18)]
****The [[Civil Aviation Administration of China]] says that flights to [[Beijing]] will be diverted to 12 [[List of airports in China|Chinese airports]] for screening amid the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202003/22/WS5e7707eea310128217281000.html (''China Daily'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iraq]]
****[[Iraq]] issues a lockdown until March 28 in an effort to contain the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/03/22/Iraq-imposes-nation-wide-lockdown-to-contain-coronavirus- (Al Arabiya)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Turkey)|Ministry of Health]] reports that the country's [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll stands at 30, with a total of 1,236 confirmed cases. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/coronavirus-death-toll-rises-to-30-in-turkey-289-new-cases-health-minister-153175 (''Hürriyet Daily News'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Syria]]
****The [[Government of Syria|government]] announces the war-torn country's first confirmed case of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/syria-confirms-first-covid-19-case-regime-health-minister (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] raises its [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll to 5,476. [https://www.wionews.com/world/italy-sees-651-new-virus-deaths-toll-nears-5500-287957 (WION)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]] 
****[[Prime Minister of Spain]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] tells the [[Congress of Deputies]] the country will to extend its state of alarm, implemented due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]], for an additional 15 days. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/22/europe/spain-coronavirus-sunday-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://english.elpais.com/politics/2020-03-22/spanish-government-to-extend-state-of-alarm-for-15-days.html (''El País'')]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 394 more deaths from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the highest number of deaths in a single 24-hour period in the country to date. The total number of confirmed cases now stands at 28,572 with 1,720 deaths. Prime Minister [[Pedro Sánchez]] says "the worst is yet to come". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-spain-tally/spains-coronavirus-deaths-surpass-1700-cases-over-28000-health-ministry-idUSKBN2190G7 (Reuters)]
****Tenor [[Plácido Domingo]] announces he has tested positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-news/breaking-placido-domingo-coronavirus-opera-21734820 (''Daily Mirror'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] reports the country's first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a 67-year-old man from the town of [[Filiași]]. [https://www.romania-insider.com/coronavirus-romania-first-death-march-22 (Romania-Insider)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in France]]
****[[France|French]] Health Minister [[Olivier Véran]] confirms the first death of a doctor treating [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] patients. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200322-france-announces-first-case-of-a-hospital-doctor-dying-from-coronavirus (France 24)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] orders a nationwide lockdown starting March 23. [https://greece.greekreporter.com/2020/03/22/greece-goes-on-coronavirus-lockdown/ (Greek Reporter)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Andorra]] reports its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2020/03/21/upshot/coronavirus-deaths-by-country.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Chancellor of Germany]] [[Angela Merkel]] self-isolates after being in contact with a doctor infected with [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/22/chancellor-angela-merkel-in-quarantine-after-contact-with-doctor-who-tested-positive-for-coronavirus.html (CNBC)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in South America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Colombia]]
****[[Riot]]s break out at several prisons in [[Colombia]] over [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] fears. Residents report explosions and gunfire inside [[La Modelo]] prison in the capital [[Bogotá]]. Inmates release a statement demanding the government allow vulnerable prisoners to be granted [[house arrest]]. [https://colombiareports.com/coronavirus-fears-spur-riots-in-colombias-overcrowded-prisons/ (Colombia Reports)]
****[[Colombia|Colombian]] Justice Minister Margarita Cabello Blanco says 23 prisoners are dead and 83 others are injured following an attempted "mass criminal escape" at [[La Modelo]] prison and other detention centers. Two guards are also in critical condition. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-colombia-prison/bogota-prison-riot-over-coronavirus-kills-nearly-two-dozen-idUSKBN2190VM (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in North America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York]]
*****Former film producer and convicted [[sex offender]] [[Harvey Weinstein]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. He is put in isolation at the [[Wende Correctional Facility]]. [https://www.thedailybeast.com/jailed-harvey-weinstein-tests-positive-for-coronavirus-report (The Daily Beast)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ohio]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Louisiana]] 
*****[[Ohio]] and [[Louisiana]] declare coronavirus lockdowns. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-usa-idUSKBN2190MQ (Reuters)]
*****[[List of governors of Ohio|Ohio governor]] [[Mike DeWine]] issues a stay-at-home order. Grocery stores, pharmacies and manufacturing industries deemed "essential" will remain open. [https://www.cleveland.com/coronavirus/2020/03/ohio-stay-at-home-order-grocery-stores-pharmacies-food-takeout-and-delivery-to-remain-open.html (The Plain Dealer)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Maryland]]
*****[[Ocean City, Maryland]] announces that their beaches will be closed to slow down the spread of coronavirus. [https://www.indystar.com/story/travel/destinations/2020/03/22/ocean-city-closes-beaches-boardwalk-coronavirus/2895106001/ (Indy Star)]
****[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] from [[Kentucky]] [[Rand Paul]] tests positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [[Mitt Romney]] and [[Mike Lee (American politician)|Mike Lee]] self-quarantine for 14-days despite not testing. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/03/22/sen-rand-paul-tests-positive-for-coronavirus-142326 (''Politico'')] [https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/488926-romney-to-self-quarantine-after-paul-tests-positive (The Hill)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announces the country is shutting down non-essential services effective midday Monday for pubs, clubs, gyms, cinemas and places of worship, while restaurants and cafes will have to switch to takeaway only. The number of cases in Australia has risen to 1,315. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-51992357 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Italy–Russia relations]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
**The [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] sends medical help and disinfection tools to Italy to battle the coronavirus. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-italy-idUSKBN219081 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Guinean legislative election]], [[2020 Guinean constitutional referendum]]
**Despite violent protests, boycotts from the political opposition and fears about potential [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Guinea|coronavirus infections]], legislative elections are held in [[Guinea]] next to a controversial referendum. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/guinea-votes-contested-referendum-parliamentary-poll-200322112000131.html (Aljazeera)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia]]
***The [[2020 AFL season]] has been postponed to May 31 after [[South Australia]] and [[Western Australia]] close their borders to all non-essential travelers, and both [[New South Wales]] and [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] engage a total lockdown. ([https://www.news.com.au/sport/afl/afl-round-one-live-updates-travel-warnings-threaten-2020-season/news-story/7d60daac2b783f10205d648b1f19fc33 News.com.au])
**[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics]]
***Fans attend the [[Olympic flame]] despite the coronavirus. [https://www.republicworld.com/world-news/rest-of-the-world-news/thousands-flock-to-see-olympic-flame-in-japan-despite-virus-fears.html (Republic World)]
***After ruling out cancelling the Olympics, the [[International Olympic Committee]] considers postponing the Olympics to 2021. They set a deadline to decide within the next four weeks. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2020/03/22/2020-tokyo-olympics-postponement-being-discussed-ioc/2894633001/ (''USA Today'')]
***The [[Canadian Olympic Committee]] and [[Canadian Paralympic Committee]] announce that they will not be sending athletes to the Summer Games in 2020. [https://www.cbc.ca/sports/olympics/canadian-olympic-committee-tokyo-2020-ioc-1.5506291 (CBC)]
